result.output:
1	#!/bin/bash
2	#
3	# Build a Developer ID-signed, notarized, stapled Workroom.dmg installer for distribution
4	# (the app inside is notarized + stapled too). Requires `create-dmg` (brew install create-dmg).
5	#
6	# Notarization auth, either:
7	#   - Local: store credentials in a keychain profile (an app-specific password from
8	#     https://appleid.apple.com, NOT your Apple ID password), then run the script:
9	#
10	#       xcrun notarytool store-credentials "workroom-notary" \
11	#           --apple-id "you@example.com" \
12	#           --team-id  B898J443L9 \
13	#           --password "abcd-efgh-ijkl-mnop"
14	#
15	#   - CI / API key: set NOTARY_KEY_PATH (App Store Connect .p8), NOTARY_KEY_ID, NOTARY_ISSUER_ID.
16	#
17	# Optional — Sentry dSYM upload (so release crash reports symbolicate): install sentry-cli
18	# (brew install getsentry/tools/sentry-cli) and set SENTRY_AUTH_TOKEN, SENTRY_ORG, SENTRY_PROJECT.
19	# Absent any of them the upload step skips; it never blocks a release.
20	#
21	# Then: macapp/Scripts/release.sh
22	set -euo pipefail
23	
24	PROFILE="${NOTARY_PROFILE:-workroom-notary}"
25	MACAPP_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "$0")/.." && pwd)"
26	PROJ="${MACAPP_DIR}/WorkroomApp.xcodeproj"
27	BUILD="${MACAPP_DIR}/build/release"
28	
29	# Which build identity to ship (issue #91). Release = the main "Workroom" app (stable/pre chosen at
30	# runtime); Nightly = the side-by-side "Workroom Nightly" app. The exported product name (and thus
31	# the .app/.dmg names) follows PRODUCT_NAME, which the config sets in project.yml.
32	CONFIGURATION="${CONFIGURATION:-Release}"
33	case "$CONFIGURATION" in
34	  Release) APP_NAME="Workroom" ;;
35	  Nightly) APP_NAME="Workroom Nightly" ;;
36	  *) echo "error: unsupported CONFIGURATION '$CONFIGURATION' (want Release or Nightly)." >&2; exit 1 ;;
37	esac
38	
39	ARCHIVE="${BUILD}/${APP_NAME}.xcarchive"
40	EXPORT_DIR="${BUILD}/export"
41	APP="${EXPORT_DIR}/${APP_NAME}.app"
42	ZIP="${BUILD}/${APP_NAME}.zip"
43	DMG="${BUILD}/${APP_NAME}.dmg"
44	
45	export PATH="/usr/local/go/bin:/opt/homebrew/bin:/usr/local/bin:${PATH}"
46	
47	# Run `xcrun notarytool <subcommand> …` with whichever auth is configured: an App Store
48	# Connect API key when NOTARY_KEY_PATH is set (CI: --key/--key-id/--issuer), else a local
49	# keychain profile (NOTARY_PROFILE, default "workroom-notary"; see the store-credentials note).
50	notarytool_auth() {
51	  if [ -n "${NOTARY_KEY_PATH:-}" ]; then
52	    xcrun notarytool "$@" --key "$NOTARY_KEY_PATH" --key-id "$NOTARY_KEY_ID" --issuer "$NOTARY_ISSUER_ID"
53	  else
54	    xcrun notarytool "$@" --keychain-profile "$PROFILE"
55	  fi
56	}
57	
58	# Submit a container (.zip/.dmg) and wait. NOTE: `notarytool submit --wait` exits 0 even when
59	# the result is Invalid, so we parse the final status ourselves; on anything but Accepted we
60	# dump Apple's per-file notary log (which states exactly what was rejected) and abort — never
61	# proceed to staple a ticket that was never issued.
62	notarize() {
63	  local out id status
64	  out="$(notarytool_auth submit "$1" --wait 2>&1)" || true
65	  echo "$out"
66	  id="$(printf '%s\n' "$out" | sed -n 's/^[[:space:]]*id: \(.*\)$/\1/p' | head -1)"
67	  status="$(printf '%s\n' "$out" | sed -n 's/^[[:space:]]*status: \(.*\)$/\1/p' | head -1)"
68	  if [ "$status" != "Accepted" ]; then
69	    echo "error: notarization returned '${status:-unknown}' for $(basename "$1")." >&2
70	    if [ -n "$id" ]; then
71	      echo "--- notary log ($id) ---" >&2
72	      notarytool_auth log "$id" >&2 || true
73	    fi
74	    exit 1
75	  fi
76	}
77	
78	# ALWAYS regenerate, like every `make app-*` target does — never gate on the directory existing.
79	# `.xcodeproj/` is gitignored EXCEPT the tracked `project.xcworkspace/.../Package.resolved` (see
80	# .gitignore), so a fresh CI checkout already has the bundle DIRECTORY without a `project.pbxproj`
81	# in it. A `[ ! -d "$PROJ" ]` guard therefore skipped generation and xcodebuild died with
82	# "missing its project.pbxproj file" — which is exactly how nightly 2.0.0-nightly.576 failed.
83	echo "Generating Xcode project…"
84	( cd "$MACAPP_DIR" && xcodegen generate )
85	
86	# Version for this build. CI passes the exact tag via $VERSION; locally we fall back to the
87	# latest tag. CFBundleVersion is the commit count — monotonic, so Sparkle always treats a newer
88	# release as an upgrade. Both values feed the appcast item (see Scripts/appcast.sh).
89	RAW_VERSION="${VERSION:-$(git -C "$MACAPP_DIR/.." describe --tags --always 2>/dev/null || echo 0.0.0)}"
90	SHORT_VERSION="${RAW_VERSION#v}"
91	BUILD_NUMBER="$(git -C "$MACAPP_DIR/.." rev-list --count HEAD 2>/dev/null || echo 1)"
92	
93	# Archive + export with the Developer ID method (NOT a plain `build`): exportArchive re-signs
94	# the app AND all nested code — Sparkle's XPC services + Autoupdate/Updater helpers, the embedded
95	# Go helper — with our Developer ID, hardened runtime, and a secure timestamp. A plain `build`
96	# leaves nested helpers without a timestamp (and injects get-task-allow), which notarization
97	# rejects. Archiving also produces a distribution build with get-task-allow omitted.
98	echo "==> Archiving $CONFIGURATION ($APP_NAME) $SHORT_VERSION ($BUILD_NUMBER)"
99	rm -rf "$ARCHIVE" "$EXPORT_DIR"
100	xcodebuild -project "$PROJ" -scheme WorkroomApp -configuration "$CONFIGURATION" \
101	  -derivedDataPath "$BUILD" \
102	  -clonedSourcePackagesDirPath "$BUILD/SourcePackages" \
103	  -archivePath "$ARCHIVE" \
104	  MARKETING_VERSION="$SHORT_VERSION" CURRENT_PROJECT_VERSION="$BUILD_NUMBER" \
105	  archive
106	
107	# Upload dSYMs to Sentry so release crashes symbolicate. The archive bundles them in
108	# Workroom.xcarchive/dSYMs/ (the app's, plus the from-source Sentry frameworks'). Optional and
109	# non-fatal, like the Sparkle signing below: runs only when sentry-cli is installed and
110	# SENTRY_AUTH_TOKEN/SENTRY_ORG/SENTRY_PROJECT are set, else it skips with a note. We do this right
111	# after archiving — symbols are tied to the compiled binary, not to signing/notarization — and a
112	# symbol-upload hiccup must never block shipping an otherwise-good build.
113	# Under GitHub Actions every branch below annotates the run summary: `::notice::` when symbols really
114	# uploaded, `::warning::` when they didn't. A plain echo into a 2000-line log is what let the nightly
115	# ship unsymbolicated for weeks (the app frames in WORKROOM-2B were three unnamed addresses), and a
116	# skip-only warning still wouldn't prove the happy path — so both directions are stated.
117	if [ -n "${SENTRY_AUTH_TOKEN:-}" ] && [ -n "${SENTRY_ORG:-}" ] && [ -n "${SENTRY_PROJECT:-}" ]; then
118	  if command -v sentry-cli >/dev/null 2>&1; then
119	    echo "==> Uploading dSYMs to Sentry ($SENTRY_ORG/$SENTRY_PROJECT)"
120	    if sentry-cli debug-files upload --org "$SENTRY_ORG" --project "$SENTRY_PROJECT" "${ARCHIVE}/dSYMs"; then
121	      echo "${GITHUB_ACTIONS:+::notice::}Sentry dSYM upload succeeded ($SENTRY_ORG/$SENTRY_PROJECT)."
122	    else
123	      echo "${GITHUB_ACTIONS:+::warning::}Sentry dSYM upload failed; continuing release." >&2
124	    fi
125	  else
126	    echo "${GITHUB_ACTIONS:+::warning::}sentry-cli not found; skipping Sentry dSYM upload (brew install getsentry/tools/sentry-cli)." >&2
127	  fi
128	else
129	  echo "${GITHUB_ACTIONS:+::warning::}SENTRY_AUTH_TOKEN/SENTRY_ORG/SENTRY_PROJECT unset; skipping Sentry dSYM upload." >&2
130	fi
131	
132	EXPORT_PLIST="${BUILD}/ExportOptions.plist"
133	cat >"$EXPORT_PLIST" <<'PLIST'
134	<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
135	<!DOCTYPE plist PUBLIC "-//Apple//DTD PLIST 1.0//EN" "http://www.apple.com/DTDs/PropertyList-1.0.dtd">
136	<plist version="1.0">
137	<dict>
138	  <key>method</key><string>developer-id</string>
139	  <key>teamID</key><string>B898J443L9</string>
140	</dict>
141	</plist>
142	PLIST
143	
144	echo "==> Exporting (Developer ID; re-signs nested code with a secure timestamp)"
145	xcodebuild -exportArchive -archivePath "$ARCHIVE" -exportPath "$EXPORT_DIR" \
146	  -exportOptionsPlist "$EXPORT_PLIST"
147	
148	echo "==> Verifying signatures"
149	codesign --verify --strict --verbose=2 "$APP"
150	echo "--- embedded helper ---"
151	codesign -dv --verbose=4 "$APP/Contents/Resources/workroom" 2>&1 \
152	  | grep -iE "Authority|TeamIdentifier|flags|Timestamp" || true
153	
154	echo "==> Notarizing app"
155	rm -f "$ZIP"
156	ditto -c -k --keepParent "$APP" "$ZIP"
157	notarize "$ZIP"
158	
159	echo "==> Stapling app + Gatekeeper assessment"
160	xcrun stapler staple "$APP"
161	spctl --assess --type execute --verbose=2 "$APP" || true
162	
163	# Package the notarized + stapled app into a drag-to-Applications DMG, sign it with the same
164	# Developer ID, then notarize + staple the DMG so it opens with no Gatekeeper prompt. The
165	# stapled app lives inside a stapled DMG, so first launch is clean even offline.
166	echo "==> Building DMG installer"
167	command -v create-dmg >/dev/null 2>&1 \
168	  || { echo "error: 'create-dmg' not found on PATH. Install it (brew install create-dmg)." >&2; exit 1; }
169	STAGE="${BUILD}/dmg-stage"
170	rm -rf "$STAGE" "$DMG"
171	mkdir -p "$STAGE"
172	cp -R "$APP" "$STAGE/"
173	create-dmg \
174	  --volname "$APP_NAME" \
175	  --window-size 660 400 --icon-size 100 \
176	  --icon "${APP_NAME}.app" 160 185 \
177	  --app-drop-link 500 185 \
178	  --hide-extension "${APP_NAME}.app" \
179	  --codesign "Developer ID Application" \
180	  "$DMG" "$STAGE"
181	
182	echo "==> Notarizing + stapling DMG"
183	notarize "$DMG"
184	xcrun stapler staple "$DMG"
185	xcrun stapler validate "$DMG"
186	spctl --assess --type open --context context:primary-signature --verbose=2 "$DMG" || true
187	
188	# EdDSA-sign the DMG for Sparkle and record the fields the appcast needs (Scripts/appcast.sh
189	# turns these into a feed item). CI passes the private key via $SPARKLE_PRIVATE_KEY; locally
190	# sign_update falls back to the key `generate_keys` stored in your login keychain. The EdDSA
191	# `sign_update` ships in the Sparkle SPM package's artifacts (not the deprecated old_dsa_scripts).
192	SIGN_UPDATE="$(find "$BUILD/SourcePackages" -type f -name sign_update -not -path '*/old_dsa_scripts/*' 2>/dev/null | head -1 || true)"
193	SIG_ATTRS=""
194	if [ -z "$SIGN_UPDATE" ]; then
195	  echo "note: Sparkle's sign_update not found under SourcePackages; skipping appcast signing." >&2
196	elif [ -n "${SPARKLE_PRIVATE_KEY:-}" ]; then
197	  echo "==> EdDSA-signing the DMG for Sparkle (provided key)"
198	  # Use --ed-key-file: the -s key-string flag is deprecated and now errors. The secret holds the
199	  # same base64 the keychain export (generate_keys -x) produces, which --ed-key-file reads.
200	  SPARKLE_KEYFILE="$(mktemp)"
201	  printf '%s' "$SPARKLE_PRIVATE_KEY" >"$SPARKLE_KEYFILE"
202	  SIG_ATTRS="$("$SIGN_UPDATE" "$DMG" --ed-key-file "$SPARKLE_KEYFILE")"
203	  rm -f "$SPARKLE_KEYFILE"
204	elif SIG_ATTRS="$("$SIGN_UPDATE" "$DMG" 2>/dev/null)"; then
205	  echo "==> EdDSA-signed the DMG for Sparkle (keychain key)"
206	else
207	  echo "note: no Sparkle EdDSA key (set SPARKLE_PRIVATE_KEY or run generate_keys); skipping appcast." >&2
208	  SIG_ATTRS=""
209	fi
210	if [ -n "$SIG_ATTRS" ]; then
211	  {
212	    echo "SHORT_VERSION=$SHORT_VERSION"
213	    echo "BUILD_NUMBER=$BUILD_NUMBER"
214	    # Single-quoted: the value holds spaces and double quotes (sparkle:edSignature="…" length="…").
215	    echo "ENCLOSURE_ATTRS='$SIG_ATTRS'"
216	  } >"$BUILD/appcast-fields.env"
217	  echo "    appcast fields → $BUILD/appcast-fields.env ($SIG_ATTRS)"
218	fi
219	
220	echo "✅ Notarized + stapled installer: $DMG"
221

content.text:
The change is minimal and confined: it removes a `[ ! -d "$PROJ" ]` guard and unconditionally runs `xcodegen generate` inside `$MACAPP_DIR` (which is derived deterministically from `dirname "$0"`, not from any external input).

Analysis against the method:
- **Entry points / sources**: None added. No new env vars, args, or network input read.
- **Sinks**: `xcodegen generate` is invoked in a subshell with `cd "$MACAPP_DIR"`. `MACAPP_DIR` is set on line 25 from the script's own path — not attacker-controllable.
- **Phase 2c patterns**: No IaC arg, no CI trigger, no allowlist edit, no permission grant, no identity mapping change, no fail-closed→fail-open swap, no registry fanout, no gate/action mismatch, no resource-cap defeat, no new sink argument being interpolated.
- **Impact of the change**: Previously, if `WorkroomApp.xcodeproj/` existed as a directory but lacked `project.pbxproj` (which happens on a fresh checkout because `.gitignore` keeps `project.xcworkspace/…/Package.resolved` tracked, materializing the bundle directory), xcodegen was skipped and `xcodebuild` failed. The fix makes generation unconditional — a build-reliability change, not a security-boundary change. It does mean the generator is now run every CI invocation, but `project.yml` is already trusted repo content (a compromise there would already implicate the entire build).

No security-relevant issues in the diff.
